digest.component_or_area: Plan-review Pass-2 prerequisite verification gate (Bedrock LLM integration)
propositions: Pass-2 prerequisite_verify step fails with HTTP 400 ValidationException after commit 6c8daf7945 added native_structured_output=True for sonnet-4-6, causing every finding to degrade to no-verification status

Plan-review and code-review contracts (22-36 optional parameters) exceed Anthropic's documented 180-second grammar compilation timeout and 24-parameter complexity cap when sent as NativeOutput schemas

output_mode must gate NativeOutput selection on both installed stack capability (outputConfig parameter support) and measured schema complexity bound (16 optional / 12 union parameters), not just model capability declaration
Schema complexity counting must recursively traverse $defs, items, and nested properties to correctly measure optional and union-typed parameters across all contract depths, not just top-level
Bedrock schema-complexity rejections must be classified distinctly from generic provider failures so operators can identify the root cause and remediation path without treating it as an outage
